notes.title: Update 0.9.6
notes.content:
Greetings,

With 0.9.6 we have introduced the following changes:

Alliance Balance Changes: 


 Increased alliance progression rewards from 5 to 10.
 Increased alliance currency reward per progression chest, from 250 to intervals of 250, starting at 500.
 Final chest of alliance progression reward gives a much larger amount than previous chests, to incentivize maxing it out.
 Increase alliance battles exp from 250 to 1250. 
 Reduced alliance power up node requirement from 25 to 15.
 Created a proper ratio between alliance currency - latinum. Now, 100 alliance crystals = 2000 latinum.
 Tweaked all alliance store prices.
 Added better biogels to the alliance store, based on player level.
 Added summon shards to an alliance store slot, shared with the existing power cell slot. Which of the two appears there is going to be random.
 Reduced points required to unlock alliance chests from an interval of 25 to an interval of 15.

Alliance UI Fixes: 


 Alliance currency now displays on all screens while in the alliance menus.
 Alliance info is now not obscured while in the alliance menu. 
 UI functionality changes: 
 Hovering over info buttons with your mouse will now require a click for that info pop-up to open thus eliminating unwanted information overload for players.
 The player ID “copy” button has been made functional. 

Bug fixes: 


 Further improvements to the Mission menu selection screen. 
 Resolution and Quality settings will now save between sessions. 
 Display issue for Seven of Nine 
Thank you for playing!

Live Long and Prosper,
- The Star Trek Legends Team

notes.title: Development Update 2024.03.25
notes.content:
Hey folks, we’d like to give a quick update into our current priorities with Star Trek Legends.

First and foremost, we’d like to thank everybody for their feedback and providing us further details to solve these issues more efficiently. We are still finalizing a build that should be forthcoming soon focused on the following issues:

 Daily Goals Not Resetting - We understand the frustration for players who have had their accounts not being able to claim rewards due to the Daily Goals not resetting for a sustained period of time.
 Claim Button Malfunction - The behavior of this is inherently tied to the above, and the issue should be resolved when we are able to deliver the fix to the Daily Goal Reset issue.
 Shuttle Recall Display Issue - Per feedback, players have reported not receiving rewards for shuttles and there is a few things happening here:

 A shuttle needs to be out at least 15 minutes before any reward can be claimed from it.
 The UI doesn’t present this information well.
 The behavior will remain the same, but we are working toward presenting the information a bit better

Survival 101+ Crashes - Games crashing and causing issues for Survival runs exceeding the level 100 mark are known and being worked on.

We’ve also had reports of PvP Access and Balance Issues. PvP Access was resolved without a new patch, so if you are having trouble accessing please report it so we can investigate. As for PvP Balance, there was some initial striation in competition that per our data should be resolving itself as players engage more with the feature. If you continue to consistently see uncompetitive match-ups please report them to us so we can cross-check again with what we’re seeing on the back end.

Lastly, there have been a number of players who have reported  lost account access / progress. We have asked folks to reach out to startreklegends@tiltingpoint.com with the details if you have experienced this. We’re working on identifying whether something got disconnected and we can reconnect the account or whether if the details were somehow lost altogether. The fix for this is still being identified and will not be included in the next patch. We’d encourage players affected by this to reach out to our support team to collect account details and help to potentially aid in identifying the issue.

Thank you again for all your help and feedback to improve the game experience.

LLAP,
-The Star Trek Legends Team

notes.title: 2024.03.04 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Survival Fixes: 

 The “Morale Up” power-up is no longer granting an “Attack Up” buff and now correctly boosts morale in Survival mode. 
 Survival rewards correctly display rewards earned by a player. 

Summoning Fixes: 

 Summoned tokens show the quantity of each pull instead of combining multiples that are earned. 
 Summoned new units now default open with skill info open.

UI/UX Functionality: 

 Several story nodes were losing back button functionality within the story node menu. This has been corrected.  
 The breadcrumb on the Daily Rewards is now displaying correctly. 
 Tech Defense icons have been updated. 
 The text on the reinforcement screen “select one crew” was behind the reinforcement text on the Steam deck. This caused interaction issues and has been fixed. 
 The color of the UI highlight glows now match the color of the nodes themselves. 
 A bug that prevented the on screen keyboard from functioning correctly after sending a message has been fixed. 

Support: 

 The correct support email is now displayed in the support pop-up: startreklegends@tiltingpoint.com
